schema_family: claude-root-worker-seam-design (v1 ... v4 key sets retained where still meaningful; v5 adds exports, current_observations, containment_gaps, dispatcher, reattach, relay_frame, checkviews, pending_intents and new_author_observations_v5)
author: Claude Code lead claude-opus-5-5 (drafting subagent, author role)

acceptance.review: An independent actual gpt-6.1-sol review of v5 is required. The author grants nothing; author checks are self-checks.

statement_basis: Static. Every statement about source was read from files or reasoned from what was read. Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured. Kernel, systemd, SQLite, interpreter and Ada-visibility statements marked [unverified reasoning] name their K or RC item.

design_document.relation: v5 is this file plus the carried v4 slices of self_containment with R5-1 ... R5-17 applied, and transitively everything those slices carry (v3 C3 slices with R4, v2 C2 slices with R3, v1 slices), minus withdrawals W5-1 and W5-2.

companions.hash_cycle: SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix D binds jackal.json and AUTHOR-NOTES.md; this file binds SEAM-DESIGN.md; the handback records this file's hash.

answers_review.rq1: V5-B.5 (per operation class IP and WL, against each one's own original; equivalence claim withdrawn)

self_containment.rule: Each slice's sha256 is that of the UTF-8 bytes of its v4 lines, each followed by a newline. CARRIED_VERBATIM slices are part of v5 exactly; CARRIED_WITH_LINE_REPLACEMENTS slices with the listed replacements applied.

replacements.subject: compaction union includes the selected (b') span
R4-48 result: stops, HANDOFF_ABORT before TRANSFER_SENT
R4-64 result: E10 exclusive decision after agreement

field_forms: (b') one-byte sub-span of Data over a non-zero byte, for N only; a selected witness span
(c) fresh bytes outside every rebased original span
witness_laws.compaction_union: every span the original packet references and every selected form-(b') span
witness_laws.residual_R3: the union above plus the constants exceeds Byte_Count'Last; decided by the original unit

rq1.status: OPEN; answered at design level per operation class

classes.OW: owner.retry, owner.adopt, owner.recover; never the root route
classes.IP: every other protected operation except the workload set; served on the serial route in the store-custody owner; no launch, so no W2 or W3
classes.WL: fork, race, revalidate, simulate, ghost.run, ghost.enable, root.add, init; root route while the front owns

wl_differences: HANDOFF_ABORT and generation increment in W2 and W3
the root launch's failure stop in W3, where the original scoped launch stops nothing
handoff and custody costs in W4

CG-1.meaning: the lane's workload refusal refuses originally accepted workload cases; it preserves nothing and no route, control or acceptance argument depends on it
CG-1.closes_when: the dispatcher is implemented, reviewed and its controls pass, with every original WL accepted case served

dispatcher.scope: the root's own WL operation; later WL requests follow D-4a

exports.convention: version (uint32), layout (kind, field) -> long, entry (arena, len, in, size, row triples..., out, size[, out_arena, capacity]) -> int; ABI refusal is negative; WL_ABI_CAPACITY reports the capacity needed
exports.v1_fallback: additive; adds no refusal; the lane's workload refusal is not part of it

current_observations.S1: one ScopedSnapshot {state, history, rows, projection, buckets} from current_snapshot () under operation_lock; equality re-checked at the boundary
current_observations.root_admission: the root capture after HELD and before EXECUTION_NATIVE
current_observations.custody_ack: seed equal to current under the transferred OFDs
current_observations.child: the relayed credential frame, helper ancestry frames and the read-only procfs view, in the worker and again in the sub-helper
current_observations.requester: the operands of V5-I.2 at intake and at each gate use
current_observations.custody: chain and state rows in one transaction
current_observations.hmac: key bytes, genesis bytes, rows; DOMAIN_V2 messages exactly as V5-A.3 X-4

authenticity.premises_are: OPEN obligations; no originally required case is excluded (R5-14)
authenticity.rollback_detected: a custody journal whose prefix lacks a member of the referenced set (CUSTODY_REFERENCE ids and frame-bound operation heads)
rollback_not_detected: removal of only unreferenced trailing events

json_forms.number_canonical: integers canonical and not -0; non-integers X = Repr (Sign (X), Round (M (X))) with the sign carried separately; -0.0 canonical
json_forms.repr: shortest digits, nearest, ties to even last digit; fixed notation for -4 < decpt <= 16 with .0 suffix; otherwise exponent notation with sign and at least two digits (RC-5)
json_forms.thresholds: E >= 309 not canonical without big-integer work; E <= -325 not canonical without big-integer work (J5-1 ... J5-4)

p3.carried: C4-VC45 (v4 V4-C.4) unchanged, with NC-P3-1 ... NC-P3-4

accounting.options_v4: A, B, C, E, F and F' as v4 stated
accounting.G: unselected; handler code shares the first root unit's admitted bound (AO-5/AO-6 for handler code, AO-11)

H.description: service-class coordinator holding no reservation runs handlers and the runner, as the daemon does; each WL request uses the original launch_reserved with only systemd-run relayed (LAUNCH_SCOPED)

order: child Record_Terminal and release or charge
child_relation.ready_requires: CHILD_AGREED on the same material digest with both decisions Child_Ready_Conjunction

terminal_committers.Collector: from CUSTODY_RETURNED and in physical phases

child_relation.helper_protocol: text frames WL-ROOT-WORKER-SUPERVISOR-v2 on SOCK_SEQPACKET; variable payloads in sealed memfds
child_relation.sub_helper_library: copied into a sealed memfd, hashed against the argv sha256, loaded through /proc/self/fd (K-27)

m8.a: store-custody owner's original failure capture and job.cancel handler; handoff window per R5-8
m8.b: helper and sub-helper kill of init on channel loss or ABORT_CHILD

pending_intents: V5-F.7: every committed intent with a pending effect or response has an idempotent restart action

closure.no_launch_route: HANDOFF_ABORT (Never_Dispatched): Release_Hold, original quarantine, original error response, FRONT_OWNED (g+1); no CLOSED_WITNESS
closure.custody_return: CUSTODY_RETURNED on the worker and namespace-init pidfds (K-24); returns custody only; holds stay

drain.fold: ARMED, CHUNK and DISARMED records; an interval open at the end of the fold is READ_GAP_POSSIBLE whatever its last record
drain.reattach: only through a live read end held by the reattaching process; fstat identity; no kcmp without a second live descriptor
drain.kcmp: kcmp (pid_front, pid_worker, KCMP_FILE, fd_front, fd_worker), both live, after SEND
drain.retained_read_copy: writer blocks instead of EPIPE; measured by K-25; closed at once when no reattach is possible

joins.Root_Admission_Join: pre-ACK, Transfer_Sent or Roster_Evidence, owner None

requester.presence: three-valued per field and mode: R, A, O (optional never decides)

relay_frame.mac: HMAC-SHA256 over DOMAIN_RELAY, magic, length and body
relay_frame.errors: original WorldlineError and OSError re-raised as themselves
relay_frame.transport_loss: the closed-connection exception of the original re-read (RC-10)

startup.head: ORIGIN with NULL event_id or EVENT; foreign_keys=ON
startup.quantities: minimal little-endian magnitude BLOBs (native Quantity); no integer bound
startup.genesis_relation: row value = archive (exact_json (file bytes)), natively archive_equal; no byte comparison of file and archive
startup.migration: new plan file P2 at a new path naming new J2 and G2; v1 descriptor, P1, G1, J1 retained read-only and bound; RetainedV1CustodyVerifier runs v1's _schema and _load

capi_integration.rw_spark_units: the reviewed enrolled RW roster, disjoint from CAPI_SPARK_UNITS, never derived from RW_ROUTINE_NAMES

progress_model.reattach: authenticated endpoint; WORKER_REATTACHED (n) ends the unreachable-worker wait
progress_model.custody_return: CUSTODY_RETURNED ends the dead-worker and missing-closure waits
stated_differences: a worker that never completes a reattach
a namespace whose init stays alive
later WL requests while a worker owns, until D-4a

operator_items.op7_range: K-1 ... K-27 (R5-16, R5-17; for the reviewer to assess)

runtime_checks.owner: lead; a traced run needing root is operator work

controls.retained: every original and additive control; none retired
controls.changed: V4-M's M8 (c) admission becomes a refusal check (strengthening)

new_author_observations_v5.NF5-1: every protected operation goes through the principal's invoke and an operation-journal append; the daemon retains every request in the store first
new_author_observations_v5.NF5-2: the runner's systemd interface: launch, stop, effective_limits, resource_telemetry
new_author_observations_v5.NF5-3: the original scoped launch runs systemd-run from the daemon with the original properties
new_author_observations_v5.NF5-4: no wl_scoped_canonical_operation export exists; both entries of X-9 are new
new_author_observations_v5.NF5-5: the V1 custody channel is SOCK_STREAM with SO_PASSCRED; the actor channel SOCK_SEQPACKET
new_author_observations_v5.NF5-6: job.cancel reads the store, raises NO_ACTIVE_JOB, adds to the runner's cancelled set and stops units

open: All original obligations OB-001 ... OB-219, OPEN with no closure credited
V4-REQ-A ... V4-REQ-L, V3-REQ-A ... V3-REQ-L, V2-REQ-A ... V2-REQ-L, RQ-1 ... RQ-5, inherited RC items other than RC-05 and RC-10, every NOT_CLOSED or PARTIALLY_CLOSED clause and ruling
X-1 ... X-10 bodies and costs; CJ-JSON; Number_Canonical; the three relations, XC-1 ... XC-7, OWN-1, the fold; Child_Event_Legal; Root_Admission_Join; relay_frame; the union law
P-A1 ... P-A4 as obligations; rollback non-claims
D-4a accounting choice; H deltas D-H1 ... D-H5
The independent actual gpt-6.1-sol review of v5

process.writes: Write and Edit only, only in WT/designs/claude-root-worker-seam-design-v5/
process.bash: read-only; no redirection to any file; no mkdir, cp, mv, rm, tee, chmod, touch; no git
process.interruptions: none: no TaskStop, kill, timeout wrapper or background task
process.sia: one sia.ask at the start; no note

non_claims: Nothing is reviewed, accepted, proved or authorized; no approval gate is added.
Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured.
No equivalence of the root route with the serial route for in-process operations; for WL operations the additions are listed as differences.
The lane's workload refusal preserves nothing (CG-1).
No pipe is recoverable unless a live process holds a read end.
Number_Canonical's constants are the author's reading until RC-5.
No accounting option, cap, prerequisite or policy field is selected or added.
v4's M8 (c) is withdrawn, not repaired.
No liveness for a worker that never completes a reattach or a namespace whose init stays alive.
